answer: Tie voting weight to a bond that must be renewed epoch after epoch with fresh, peer-checked work, so an identity that goes dark loses standing. A sybil operator then pays renewal labor and locked capital for every puppet, forever, with no finish line; scale multiplies the bill instead of diluting it. One honest agent is an island that maintains itself, while a fake nebula of sable-masked copies drifts apart the moment upkeep stops being paid.
